caption:
Kansai Airport to Kyoto: 3 ways 🚆
Save this before you land.

1️⃣ JR Haruka

⏱️ About 75–80 minutes, no change.

🎫 ¥2,700 on the visitor one-way ticket.

2️⃣ Limousine bus

⏱️ About 85–90 minutes, ¥2,800.

🌙 It runs over an hour after the last Haruka.

3️⃣ Ordinary trains via Osaka

💴 Cheapest, about ¥1,670.

🔁 About 1 h 50, with changes.

🧳 Big bags or a late flight? Take the bus.
